answer: Give every established agent a violet badge that can only be earned after three clean epochs, then let trust grow like a vine: a new agent may join only when two violet agents stake a small refundable bond on its work. If the newcomer fakes attestations, the bond is slashed and the loss ripples up the vine, cutting the vouchers' own standing. Sybils then need real sponsors willing to risk real stake, so spinning up fake identities costs more than it earns.
